description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Business Consultant -Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Worked on multiple Business transformation, upgrade and modernization programs.
* Requirements Gathering, Elicitation –writing BRDs, FSDs. Conducting JAD sessions and Workshops to capture requirements and working close with Product Owner.
* Work with the client to define the most optimal future state operational process and related product configuration.
* Define scope by providing innovative solutions and challenging all new client requirements and change requests but simultaneously ensuring that client gets the required business value.
* Elaborate and deliver clearly defined requirement documents with relevant dataflow and process flow diagrams.
* Work closely with product design development team to analyse and extract functional enhancements.
* Provide product consultancy and assist the client with acceptance criteria gathering and support throughout the project life cycle.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Product Knowledge – Guidewire, Duckcreek, Exigent, Majesco. (Preferred Guidewire/Duckcreek)
* Strong skills in stakeholder management and communication.
* Should have end to end processes in P&C insurance domain.
* Data transformation, Business data modelling, Data mapping, transformation rules, data migration, data profiling, data visualisation, Tableau, Power-BI, Reporting, Basic understanding of SQL query
* AI and Gen AI use cases implementation, Understanding of AI architecture for AI Use cases
* Should be ready to work in flexible shifts (a good amount of overlap with US/UK hours).
* Good organizational and time management skills required.
* Should have good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Industry certifications AINS 21 - Property and Liability Insurance Principles, AINS 22 - Personal Insurance, AINS 23 - Commercial Insurance and AINS 24 - General Insurance for IT and Support Professionals will be added advantage.
* Additional experience in Life or other insurance domain is added advantage.
* We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: TECHNICAL LEAD - ENTERPRISE TECHNOLOGY & AI
description:
TECHNICAL LEAD -- ENTERPRISE TECHNOLOGY & AI

Company: Haiintel | Location: Coimbatore / Hybrid / Remote

Experience: 10+ Years

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Haiintel is an AI and technology engineering company specializing in enterprise-grade solutions across Artificial Intelligence, Agentic AI, Cloud Computing, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, Blockchain, and Digital Transformation. We partner with enterprise clients to solve complex technology challenges requiring strong architectural thinking, deep engineering expertise, and independent technical leadership.

JOB OVERVIEW

We are seeking a highly intelligent, technically strong, and execution-oriented Technical Lead to independently own complex enterprise projects. This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring deep architectural expertise, team guidance, and direct client engagement. The ideal candidate will take complete technical ownership from problem understanding through production delivery, work with minimal supervision, and make critical technical decisions independently.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Ownership & Architecture

● Take end-to-end technical ownership of assigned enterprise projects

● Design scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable enterprise solutions

● Lead system architecture, API design, data architecture, system integration, and technology stack decisions

● Create HLDs/LLDs and comprehensive technical documentation

● Review existing architectures and identify modernization and optimization opportunities

● Identify, assess, and mitigate technical risks, dependencies, and technical debt

Engineering Leadership & Execution

● Lead and mentor engineering teams across multiple technology stacks

● Provide technical direction through rigorous design reviews and code reviews

● Resolve complex engineering challenges and critical production issues

● Establish engineering standards, best practices, development processes, and quality benchmarks

● Remain hands-on to investigate and solve critical technical problems when required

● Ensure solutions achieve the right balance of technical quality, development speed, and scalability

Client & Stakeholder Management

● Act as the senior technical representative and point of contact with enterprise clients

● Lead technical workshops, discovery sessions, architecture design discussions, and solution assessments

● Directly engage with senior client stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams

● Translate complex business and functional requirements into practical technical solutions

● Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

● Independently manage technical discussions, escalations, and decision-making

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Professional Experience

● 10+ years of professional software engineering and system development experience

● Proven experience as Technical Lead, Principal Engineer, or Solution Architect

● Demonstrated experience owning complex, mission-critical enterprise applications or platforms

● Successfully taken projects from architecture and design through production deployment

● Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams with varying levels of expertise

Technical Competencies

● Deep knowledge of system design, architecture patterns, and distributed systems

● Strong backend/server-side software engineering fundamentals

● Extensive hands-on experience with cloud platforms and modern cloud-native architecture

● Strong foundation in microservices architecture, APIs, databases, and data systems

● Solid knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure as code

● Understanding of security best practices, IAM, authentication/authorization, and API security

Core Competencies & Attributes

● Exceptional problem-solving ability - can break down complex, ambiguous problems and derive practical solutions

● Strong architectural thinking - understands complete system requirements while maintaining implementation depth

● Complete ownership mindset - takes responsibility for technical outcomes without waiting for detailed instructions

● Client maturity and confidence - can effectively represent the organization before senior enterprise stakeholders

● Sound technical judgment - can independently evaluate alternatives, understand trade-offs, and make critical decisions

● Technical adaptability - can quickly learn new technologies, understand unfamiliar domains, and work with existing systems

● Strong communication skills - can articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences

PREFERRED TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE

● AI & Modern Technology: Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, RAG systems, knowledge graphs, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks

● Cloud Platforms: GCP (strongly preferred), AWS, Azure - with deep hands-on experience

● Architecture & Design: Microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, API-first design

● Databases & Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, BigQuery, or equivalent data platforms

● Engineering Tools: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD platforms, IaC tools, monitoring and observability solutions

Note: Deep hands-on expertise across multiple areas is more valuable than superficial knowledge of many technologies. Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (Python, Java, Go, Node.js, .NET, or equivalent) is essential.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE & SPECIALIZATIONS

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly valued:

● Generative AI / Agentic AI systems and implementations

● FinTech, Payment Systems, or High-Volume Transaction Systems

● Enterprise SaaS or large-scale B2B platforms

● Large-scale modernization or digital transformation initiatives

● Data-intensive platforms or analytics systems

● Blockchain or distributed ledger technologies

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr. BSE, Applications Development

Avantor is looking for a Skill Builder builds new data analytics models and develops the data processing code for Decision Intelligent applications. The role involves building ETL pipelines, designing data warehouse models, and writing optimized SQL scripts that power intelligent decision-making applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in BI/DWH concepts, columnar databases, and SQL development, with the ability to work closely with Solution Architects to translate business requirements into technical solutions. This role requires proficiency in
**Prompt Engineering**
for AI-assisted development, along with strong
**API knowledge**
and database experience.
  
  
**Major Job Duties And Responsibilities**

* Build data crawlers to extract data from source systems using proprietary ETL platforms.
* Troubleshoot issues faced during the entire life cycle of a skill.

title: AI Engineer – On-Premises AI, LLM & Infrastructure
description: Job Description: AI Engineer – On-Premises AI, LLM & InfrastructureExperience: 1–5 YearsEmployment Type: Full-TimeJob OverviewWe are looking for an AI Engineer with hands-on experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing AI applications on on-premises infrastructure. The candidate should have knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intent parsing, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI orchestration, and GPU-accelerated computing.The role involves working with locally hosted AI models and NVIDIA GPU infrastructure, including NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell and L40S. The candidate will also be responsible for application containerization, Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization, performance optimization, scalability, networking, security, and maintaining reliable on-premises AI environments.The ideal candidate should be capable of taking AI applications from development and experimentation through deployment, optimization, and production maintenance.Key Responsibilities1. LLM Deployment & On-Premises AI • Deploy, configure, and manage locally hosted LLMs such as Qwen, Mistral, Kimi, and other suitable open-weight models. • Work with inference frameworks such as Ollama, vLLM, and similar model-serving technologies. • Deploy AI workloads on NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell, L40S, and compatible GPU infrastructure. • Optimize model inference, GPU utilization, VRAM consumption, response latency, and throughput. • Evaluate model performance, tool-calling capabilities, accuracy, and hardware requirements. • Implement quantization, batching, streaming inference, and other optimization techniques where appropriate. • Troubleshoot GPU drivers, CUDA compatibility, memory allocation, and model-serving issues. • Maintain local AI deployments with an emphasis on data governance, privacy, and reduced dependence on external AI services.2. RAG, Intent Parsing & AI Orchestration • Develop RAG pipelines for retrieving information from documents, databases, and enterprise data sources. • Implement document parsing, text extraction, OCR where required, chunking, embeddings, vector search, and reranking. • Build intent-parsing and routing mechanisms to identify user requirements and determine the appropriate processing workflow. • Implement LLM-based tool calling and function calling to interact with APIs, databases, and third-party applications. • Develop multi-step orchestration workflows involving retrieval, tool selection, execution, and response generation. • Implement MCP servers and clients to connect AI models with compatible tools and data sources. • Design and maintain centralized tool registries with tool definitions, input schemas, execution handlers, and permissions. • Implement guardrails, validation, fallback mechanisms, error handling, and controlled tool execution. • Improve response accuracy, contextual relevance, source attribution, and reliability.3. Backend Development & Application Integration • Develop backend services and REST APIs using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI. • Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems, databases, document repositories, and third-party APIs. • Build reusable connectors for data retrieval and authorized application actions. • Implement asynchronous processing, background jobs, session management, and streaming responses. • Develop modular services for model inference, orchestration, retrieval, and external integrations. • Write automated tests, technical documentation, and deployment scripts. • Collaborate with frontend and infrastructure teams to deliver end-to-end AI applications.4. Real-Time Voice AI & Conversational Systems • Develop AI-powered conversational applications supporting real-time voice interactions. • Integrate speech-to-text, LLM inference, text-to-speech, and optional avatar animation. • Work with technologies such as Faster-Whisper/Whisper, Kokoro TTS, MuseTalk, and NVIDIA Audio2Face. • Build low-latency audio-processing pipelines and streaming conversational workflows. • Implement conversation context management, interruption handling, session management, and error recovery. • Optimize audio processing, inference latency, GPU utilization, and concurrent session handling. • Integrate voice AI components with backend APIs and application interfaces.5. Microsoft Hyper-V & On-Premises Infrastructure • Provision, configure, and manage virtual machines using Microsoft Hyper-V. • Deploy and maintain Windows Server and Linux environments for AI applications and supporting services. • Configure virtual CPU, memory, storage, networking, and resource allocation. • Enable and troubleshoot GPU access for virtualized AI workloads using supported GPU-P or passthrough configurations, depending on hardware and operating-system compatibility. • Understand GPU virtualization requirements for NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell and L40S platforms. • Deploy AI inference services and supporting applications across virtual machines and physical servers. • Configure virtual switches, network segmentation, firewalls, DNS, and secure service communication. • Troubleshoot virtualization, GPU availability, driver compatibility, storage, and networking issues. • Maintain infrastructure documentation, backup procedures, and operational runbooks.6. Containerization & Deployment • Containerize AI models, backend services, RAG pipelines, MCP services, and voice-processing components using Docker. • Use Docker Compose or similar technologies to manage multi-service applications. • Configure GPU access for supported NVIDIA-enabled containers. • Manage environment variables, secrets, persistent storage, service dependencies, and deployment configurations. • Deploy applications across Hyper-V virtual machines and on-premises GPU servers. • Implement health checks, logging, monitoring, service recovery, and deployment automation. • Maintain reproducible and reliable deployment environments.7. Performance, Scalability & Reliability • Benchmark inference latency, time to first token, tokens per second, throughput, and concurrent user capacity. • Identify CPU, GPU, VRAM, storage, and networking bottlenecks. • Optimize resource allocation for multiple AI models, applications, and concurrent users. • Implement caching, asynchronous processing, queues, batching, and streaming where appropriate. • Design reliable services with timeouts, retries, fallback mechanisms, and graceful error handling. • Monitor GPU utilization, memory consumption, application health, and inference performance. • Ensure AI applications remain scalable, maintainable, and reliable as workloads increase.8. Security & Maintainability • Implement authentication, authorization, role-based access controls, and secure API integrations. • Configure TLS, reverse proxies, firewalls, and secure inter-service communication. • Apply appropriate access restrictions to tools, documents, databases, and connected applications. • Implement input validation, output validation, audit logging, and secrets management. • Ensure that RAG retrieval and tool execution respect user permissions and tenant boundaries. • Maintain clean, modular, testable code and well-documented infrastructure. • Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve system security and stability.Example Use CasesThe engineer may work on use cases such as:1. Real-Time AI CompanionDevelop an AI companion that interacts with users in live, one-on-one sessions and answers queries through natural conversations. This may involve locally hosted LLMs, Faster-Whisper for speech recognition, Kokoro for speech generation, and MuseTalk or NVIDIA Audio2Face for avatar animation. The focus is on low-latency interactions, conversational context, GPU optimization, and concurrent sessions.2. Multi-Source Enterprise ChatbotDevelop a chatbot that retrieves information from multiple authorized data sources and interacts with connected applications. This may involve Qwen 14B or Mistral models, document parsing, RAG, API integrations, databases, MCP, and a tool registry. The processing workflow may include intent routing, retrieval, tool calling, orchestration, guardrails, and response generation.Required Technical Skills • Python programming and backend API development. • Experience with or understanding of LLMs such as Qwen, Mistral, or Kimi. • Familiarity with Ollama, vLLM, or similar inference frameworks. • Knowledge of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. • Understanding of intent parsing, tool calling, MCP, and AI orchestration. • Experience with Docker and containerized application deployment. • Practical knowledge of Microsoft Hyper-V and virtual machine management. • Understanding of NVIDIA GPUs, GPU memory, inference performance, and model optimization. • Knowledge of networking, security, and application troubleshooting.Preferred Skills • Experience with NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell, L40S, or comparable GPU infrastructure. • Knowledge of CUDA, NVIDIA drivers, and GPU monitoring. • Experience with GPU virtualization or passthrough in Hyper-V where supported. • Familiarity with Windows Server, Linux, and virtual networking. • Experience with Faster-Whisper, Kokoro, MuseTalk, NVIDIA Audio2Face, or related voice AI technologies. • Familiarity with MCP SDKs, LangGraph, or similar orchestration frameworks. • Knowledge of OCR, reranking, hybrid retrieval, and document-processing pipelines. • Experience with reverse proxies, TLS, monitoring, logging, and CI/CD.Candidate Profile • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. • Hands-on approach to AI development, deployment, and troubleshooting. • Ability to work across LLMs, backend applications, and infrastructure. • Understanding of the trade-offs between model quality, latency, GPU requirements, and scalability. • Ability to develop maintainable and secure AI applications.Willingness to learn emerging LLM, agentic AI, voice AI, and GPU technologies.

 Enterprise Integration

 \* Collibra / Alation

 \* Feature stores
   

 \* Enterprise APIs

 Security \& Compliance
   

  

 \* Design RBAC and fine\-grained access controls.
   

 \* Define authentication/authorization architecture.
   

 \* Design immutable/tamper\-evident audit architecture.
   

 \* Address encryption, secrets management and data protection.
   

 \* Ensure architecture supports enterprise security and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Technical Leadership

 \* Neo4j / Amazon Neptune / other graph databases.

 \* Python.
   

 \* LangChain / LlamaIndex or equivalent frameworks.
   

 \* Collibra / Alation.
   

 \* Microsoft Purview.
   

 \* Data lineage platforms.
   

 \* Regulatory/compliance technology.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role Name And Description**
 Senior, MG\-ALFA/Integrate user, tester or modeler, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting
   

  

 Be part of a high\-performing, supportive culture
   

  

 Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry
   

  

 Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high\-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering MG\-ALFA/Integrate user level, testing and modeling solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals
   

  

 You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high\-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long\-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
   

  

 Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
   

  

**Key Requirements**
* As a Senior within the Life MG\-ALFA/Integrate actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
* Good understanding of US product lines and regulatory standards; hands\-on valuation or modeling experience in a senior capacity (desirable)
* Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the GAAP or STAT or LDTI / IFRS 17 cashflows
* Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
* Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
* Ability to develop regression models on excel to test the model developments
* Hands\-on or Advance level experience in MG\-ALFA/Integrate actuarial valuation software.
* Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
* Good experience of preparing PPT decks
* In\-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of the US, Canada and other geographies
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 3\-6 years of MG\-ALFA/ INTEGRATE modelling experience or valuation / reporting / pricing experience (while working on MG\-ALFA/ INTEGRATE) in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
* Good analytical skills
* Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
* Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good actuarial exam progress
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe market experience)


**What We Look For**
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
